list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (€)
list.description: Minimum contract value filter. A panel only counts a contract when |preço contratual| is greater than or equal to this amount, in euros. The loaded data already leaves out contracts below €10 (the is_below_min_value ingest rule, MIN_VALUE in src/base_gov/stats.py), so 0 and 10 give the same result. €5 000 / €20 000 / €75 000 are the informal reference points used in the notebooks — they are NOT legal CCP thresholds. The absolute value is used, because negative prices occur in the source data.

list.name: contract_type
list.label: Contract type
list.query: Ajuste direto : ajuste_direto,Concurso público : concurso_publico,Consulta prévia : consulta_previa,Other : other
list.description: Procedure family (procedure_family, from contracts.tipo_procedimento). Other = every procedure outside the three named families.

list.name: adjudicante
list.label: Adjudicante (name or NIF)
list.query: SELECT min(v.adjudicante_name) || ' — ' || v.adjudicante_id AS __text, v.adjudicante_id AS __value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE v.is_municipio AND v.adjudicante_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.adjudicante_id ORDER BY 1

list.name: adjudicatario
list.label: Adjudicatário (name or NIPC)
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN entity_id ~ '^[0-9]{9}$' THEN name || ' — ' || entity_id ELSE name END AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicatarios ORDER BY name, entity_id

list.name: contract_id
list.label: Contract ID
list.description: Show one contract by its BASE idcontrato. Leave empty for all.

panels.title: Rows shown
panels.description: The table below is capped at LIMIT 5000 rows, newest first; this count makes a silent truncation visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_shown FROM (SELECT v.idcontrato FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND v.is_municipio AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) AND (${contract_id:sqlstring} = '' OR v.idcontrato = nullif(regexp_replace(${contract_id:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint) LIMIT 5000) t

SELECT v.adjudicante_id AS "adjudicante_id", v.celebrated_at AS "Date", v.adjudicante_name AS "Adjudicante", a.adjudicatario_names AS "Adjudicatário(s)", v.objecto_contrato AS "Objecto", v.desc_contrato AS "Descrição", v.preco_contratual AS "Preço", v.tipo_contrato AS "Tipo", v.cpv AS "CPV", v.idcontrato AS "ID" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_agg(a2.adjudicatario_name, ', ' ORDER BY a2.adjudicatario_name) AS adjudicatario_names FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a2 WHERE a2.idcontrato = v.idcontrato) a ON true WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a3 WHERE a3.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a3.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND v.is_municipio AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) AND (${contract_id:sqlstring} = '' OR v.idcontrato = nullif(regexp_replace(${contract_id:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint) ORDER BY v.celebrated_at DESC LIMIT 5000
